gloss: preview screening; advance showing (of a film)

definitions.gloss: preview screening; advance showing; press screening
definitions.explanation: A screening of a film held before its official release, typically for critics, media, and invited guests. Also includes public preview events held as promotional activities.

examples.japanese: {試写会|ししゃかい}に{招待|しょうたい}された。
examples.english: I was invited to a preview screening.

examples.japanese: {新作|しんさく}{映画|えいが}の{試写会|ししゃかい}に{当選|とうせん}した。
examples.english: I won tickets to the preview screening of the new movie.

examples.japanese: {試写会|ししゃかい}では{主演|しゅえん}{俳優|はいゆう}の{舞台挨拶|ぶたいあいさつ}もあり、{会場|かいじょう}は{大|おお}いに{盛|も}り{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: The preview screening also featured a stage greeting from the lead actor, and the venue was very lively.

notes:
A common term in the Japanese entertainment industry. Preview screenings serve both as promotional events and as a way for critics to review films before release.

FORMS:
{試写|ししゃ} (test screening) + {会|かい} (event, gathering)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {試写会|ししゃかい}に{招待|しょうたい}する: to invite to a preview screening
- {試写会|ししゃかい}に{当選|とうせん}する: to win a spot at a preview screening
- {試写会|ししゃかい}に{応募|おうぼ}する: to apply for a preview screening
- マスコミ{試写|ししゃ}: press screening
- {完成|かんせい}{試写会|ししゃかい}: completion preview (screening of the finished film)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, many preview screenings are open to the general public through lotteries or magazine/website promotions. Winning ({当選|とうせん}) a spot is a popular way to see anticipated films early. These events often include {舞台挨拶|ぶたいあいさつ} (stage greetings) by the cast.
